title: Clearance.
officialText:
A draft hood shall be located so its relief opening is not less than 6 inches (152 mm) from any surface except
that of the appliance it serves and the venting system to which the draft hood is connected. Where a greater or lesser clearance is
indicated on the appliance label, the clearance shall be not less than that specified on the label. Such clearances shall not be
reduced.
